name: Kanuchi - Kuroki Tsubasa no Shou
original_name: カヌチ 黒き翼の章
source:
Taking from where the Shiroki chapter left, Kayana and Aki are now in the country of Yasuna as prisoners. The final showdown is drawing near...

[From [url=http://www.my-neoromance.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=316:kanuchi-kuroki-tsubasa-no-shou&catid=64&Itemid=87]My Neo Romance[/url]]
translation:
承接「白翼之章」的結局，迦耶那與亞紀如今成了俘虜，身陷安那國。最後的決戰日益逼近……

[摘自[url=http://www.my-neoromance.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=316:kanuchi-kuroki-tsubasa-no-shou&catid=64&Itemid=87]My Neo Romance[/url]]
